name: SUBURB HELL VAMPIRE
source:
Rumors flutter around the neighborhood about the run down looking house on the corner of the street. Nobody can quite pin down what goes on there, whether it be criminal activity, or perhaps something more supernatural. That is, until a girl named Faith bumps into the resident of the home: The neighborhood's local vampire, Vi.

Follow Vi and Faith as their relationship blooms, before it rots away into nothingness.

[From [url=https://stardustflesh.itch.io/suburb-hell-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
